product: DWD RADOLAN YW: 5-minute quasi-adjusted radar precipitation (basis RY, RH, RW), CDC daily files from the recent/ folder
unit: 0.01 mm per 5 min (the YW header PR E-02, INT 5): the same unit as Bright Sky /radar precipitation_5, so the values are served as they are
timestamps: epoch seconds UTC from the YW header (Zeitpunkt der Messung); taken as the END of the 5 minutes, as dwd-radar.js assumes for Bright Sky (frame T holds [T-5min, T)). DWD does not say end or start: if it is the start, every radar time is 5 min later (+/-5 min)

grid.name: RADOLAN national composite 900x900, 1 km
grid.projection: polar stereographic, sphere R = 6370.04 km, true at 60N, central meridian 10E
grid.file_row_order: row 0 = southernmost, each row west -> east (data block starts at the SW pixel)

point_index_from_sw.units: cell-centre units: integer = a cell centre, x east, y north

window.orientation: north-up like Bright Sky: p[0] is the northernmost row, each row west -> east

brightsky_crop.note: what a live Bright Sky /radar?distance=2000 would return: 5x5 cells, bounds round(p - 2) .. round(p + 2) per axis (checked against a live Berlin answer on 2026-09-28: bbox [414, 782, 418, 786] on its 1200x1100 grid, latlon_position {x: 1.502, y: 2.26}, rows north-up, integer = cell centre). rows/cols are inclusive indices into `window` (p).
